'''Scorpia's guardians''' appear while fighting [[Scorpia]]. Two appear on the ''next'' attack after Scorpia reaches 99 health or lower, even if you splash. The guardians will each heal Scorpia for 8 health every 1.8 seconds, shown with a curse projectile animation, and can do so from up to 3 tiles away. If they do not heal Scorpia in 15 seconds, they will despawn. If killed they will not respawn, even if they manage to heal Scorpia back to full health.

Players can either freeze them with [[Ice Burst|ice burst]]/[[Ice Barrage|barrage]] or [[snare]] and lure Scorpia away to cause them to despawn, or kill them.
